name: Common Ground Observatory (Lean 4.33.0 + Unified Shards)
postCreateCommand: curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/master/elan-init.sh -sSf | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none && $HOME/.elan/bin/elan toolchain install $(cat lean-toolchain) && npm install -g wrangler@4.14.0 @google/gemini-cli && python3 -B observatory/scripts/reconstruct-bundle-data.py
